card.name: "Has not identified" in geriatric statements
card.fires_on: The word "identified" in the stock geriatric-use sentence "clinical experience has not identified differences in responses". It also fires weakly on "with" or "has" in contraindication or caution statements about a patient history.

modes.label: Geriatric use sentence
modes.description: The verb "identified" after "has not" in the statement about elderly versus younger subjects.
modes.example: Other reported clinical experience has not<< identified>> differences in responses between the elderly and younger
